data.name: CatalogueLanguage
data.comment: The language this catalogue is written in, as a language code. It decides which form of a counted phrase a count takes, from the entries named _One, _Other and so on. A translation sets its own.

data.name: StatusTasks_One
data.comment: The status bar's count of the tasks on show. {0} is the count.

data.name: StatusTasks_Other
data.comment: The status bar's count of the tasks on show. {0} is the count.

data.name: SyncPending_Other
data.comment: How many writes are queued. {0} is the count. English reads the same at one as at ten, so there's no _One.

data.name: SyncFailed_Other
data.comment: How many writes Todoist turned down, which the failed changes window lists. {0} is the count. English reads the same at one as at ten, so there's no _One.

data.name: DueAdvancing
data.comment: In a recurring task's due column, in place of its date, from ticking it off until the server says when it's next due. Lower case: it sits after the repeat mark, where a date would.

data.name: MenuFile
data.comment: The File menu on the menu bar: new tasks, projects and sections, syncing, settings, and signing out.

data.name: MenuEdit
data.comment: The Edit menu on the menu bar: undo, search and the command palette.

data.name: MenuView
data.comment: The View menu on the menu bar: moving between views, what the list and the panel under it show, and the panel's zoom.

data.name: MenuTask
data.comment: The Task menu on the menu bar, which holds the same commands as a task's right-click menu.

data.name: MenuOrganise
data.comment: The menu for the sidebar's rows: renaming, deleting, starring and moving projects, sections and labels.

data.name: MenuHelp
data.comment: The Help menu on the menu bar: checking for updates, and the about box.

data.name: MenuPriority
data.comment: A submenu inside the Task menu and the right-click menu, holding the four priorities. Its letter only has to differ from the other entries in those two menus.

data.name: CommandComplete
data.comment: Ticks off the selected task. Shown in place of "Reopen" while the task isn't done.

data.name: CommandReopen
data.comment: Puts a completed task back. Shown in place of "Complete" while the task is done.

data.name: CommandRename
data.comment: Renames the selected task where it sits in the list, which is why there's no ellipsis.

data.name: CommandNewSubtask
data.comment: Adds a task under the selected one, asking for its name first.

data.name: CommandDue
data.comment: Opens the box for setting the selected task's due date, the day it's planned for.

data.name: CommandDeadline
data.comment: Opens the box for setting the selected task's deadline, the day it has to be finished by. Not the same thing as its due date.

data.name: CommandPriority1
data.comment: The number is Todoist's own, highest first, and should stay as it is.

data.name: CommandPriority2
data.comment: The second of Todoist's four priorities. The number is Todoist's own and should stay as it is.

data.name: CommandPriority3
data.comment: The third of Todoist's four priorities. The number is Todoist's own and should stay as it is.

data.name: CommandPriority4
data.comment: The priority a task has when nobody's given it one.

data.name: CommandLabels
data.comment: Todoist's labels, the tags on a task — not the text of anything.

data.name: CommandReminders
data.comment: Opens the list of the selected task's reminders, where they're added and removed.

data.name: CommandIndent
data.comment: Makes the task a sub-task of the one above it.

data.name: CommandOutdent
data.comment: Lifts a sub-task out to sit beside its parent.

data.name: CommandMoveUp
data.comment: Moves the task one place up among the tasks beside it.

data.name: CommandMoveDown
data.comment: Moves the task one place down among the tasks beside it.

data.name: CommandMoveTo
data.comment: Sends the task to another project or section, picked in a dialog.

data.name: CommandShowInTodoist
data.comment: Opens the task's page on Todoist's website.

data.name: CommandDelete
data.comment: Deletes the selected task.

data.name: CommandRenameProject
data.comment: Also shown, greyed, over a sidebar row that can't be renamed — so it says what the entry is for.

data.name: CommandRenameSection
data.comment: Renames the section selected in the sidebar, where it sits.

data.name: CommandRenameLabel
data.comment: Renames the label selected in the sidebar, where it sits.

data.name: CommandDeleteProject
data.comment: Also shown, greyed, over a sidebar row that can't be deleted.

data.name: CommandDeleteSection
data.comment: Deletes the section selected in the sidebar.

data.name: CommandDeleteLabel
data.comment: Deletes the label selected in the sidebar.

data.name: CommandAddToFavourites
data.comment: Stars the selected project or label, putting it in the sidebar's Favourites.

data.name: CommandRemoveFromFavourites
data.comment: Takes the star off the selected project or label, and it leaves the sidebar's Favourites. Shown in place of "Add to favourites" once it's starred.

data.name: CommandMoveProjectUp
data.comment: Also shown, greyed, over a sidebar row that has no order of its own to change.

data.name: CommandMoveProjectDown
data.comment: Moves the project selected in the sidebar one place down among the projects beside it.

data.name: CommandMoveSectionUp
data.comment: Moves the section selected in the sidebar one place up within its project.

data.name: CommandMoveSectionDown
data.comment: Moves the section selected in the sidebar one place down within its project.

data.name: CommandNewTask
data.comment: Opens the quick-add window with the project, label or day being viewed already filled in.

data.name: CommandNewProject
data.comment: Adds a project to the sidebar.

data.name: CommandNewSection
data.comment: Adds a section to a project.

data.name: CommandQuickAdd
data.comment: Opens the small window that adds a task from one typed line.

data.name: CommandSyncNow
data.comment: Syncs with Todoist straight away rather than waiting for the next one.

data.name: CommandHistory
data.comment: Opens the list of changes made in the app, most recent first.

data.name: CommandCompletedTasks
data.comment: Ticked in the menu while completed tasks are shown in the list. Names the thing, not the action: it never changes to say show or hide.

data.name: CommandExpandAll
data.comment: Opens every task in the list to show its sub-tasks.

data.name: CommandCollapseAll
data.comment: Closes every task in the list, so only the ones at the top level show.

data.name: CommandDefaultOrder
data.comment: Puts the list back in the account's own order after it's been sorted by a column.

data.name: CommandDetails
data.comment: Ticked while the panel under the list is open. The panel shows a task's description and its comments.

data.name: CommandViewDescription
data.comment: Opens the panel under the list on the selected task's description.

data.name: CommandViewComments
data.comment: Opens the panel under the list on the selected task's comments.

data.name: CommandZoomIn
data.comment: Makes the description's text larger.

data.name: CommandZoomOut
data.comment: Makes the description's text smaller.

data.name: CommandZoomReset
data.comment: Puts the description's text back to its usual size.

data.name: CommandUndo
data.comment: Takes back the last change made in the app.

data.name: CommandSearch
data.comment: Puts the cursor in the search box above the task list.

data.name: CommandPalette
data.comment: Opens a box listing every command and view, filtered as you type.

data.name: CommandPreviousView
data.comment: Selects the sidebar row above the current one.

data.name: CommandNextView
data.comment: Selects the sidebar row below the current one.

data.name: CommandSettings
data.comment: Opens the settings dialog.

data.name: CommandCheckForUpdates
data.comment: Looks for a newer release of Termyn, and offers to open its page when there is one.

data.name: CommandAbout
data.comment: Termyn is the app's name and isn't translated.

data.name: CommandReconnect
data.comment: Offered once Todoist has turned the token away. The ellipsis is for the token dialog it opens.

data.name: CommandSignOut
data.comment: The ellipsis is for the question it asks first, about what signing out removes from this computer.

data.name: CommandExit
data.comment: Closes Termyn altogether, rather than leaving it in the tray.

data.name: KeyCtrl
data.comment: The Ctrl key, in a shortcut beside a menu entry. Use the name printed on keyboards in your language.

data.name: KeyShift
data.comment: The Shift key, in a shortcut beside a menu entry. Use the name printed on keyboards in your language.

data.name: KeyAlt
data.comment: The Alt key, in a shortcut beside a menu entry. Use the name printed on keyboards in your language.

data.name: KeyWin
data.comment: The Windows key, in a shortcut beside a menu entry.

data.name: KeySpace
data.comment: The space bar, in a shortcut beside a menu entry.

data.name: KeyEnter
data.comment: The Enter key, in a shortcut beside a menu entry. Use the name printed on keyboards in your language.

data.name: KeyTab
data.comment: The Tab key, in a shortcut beside a menu entry. Use the name printed on keyboards in your language.

data.name: KeyEscape
data.comment: The Esc key, in a shortcut beside a menu entry.

data.name: KeyDelete
data.comment: The Delete key, in a shortcut beside a menu entry, written short the way keyboards print it. Use the name printed on keyboards in your language.

data.name: KeyInsert
data.comment: The Insert key, in a shortcut beside a menu entry. Use the name printed on keyboards in your language.

data.name: SyncStatusSyncing
data.comment: In the status bar while a sync with Todoist is under way.

data.name: SyncStatusOffline
data.comment: In the status bar while Todoist can't be reached: the list is the copy kept on this computer, and changes wait to be sent.

data.name: SyncStatusPaused
data.comment: In the status bar while Todoist has asked for syncing to slow down, and it isn't known for how long.

data.name: SyncStatusPausedRetry
data.comment: {0} is the seconds until the paused loop tries again.

data.name: SyncStatusReconnectNeeded
data.comment: In the status bar once Todoist has turned the token away. Nothing syncs until a new one is given.

data.name: SyncStatusSynced
data.comment: In the status bar after a sync, when how long ago it was isn't known.

data.name: SyncStatusSyncedAgo
data.comment: {0} is a span such as "3m ago".

data.name: SyncStatusNever
data.comment: In the status bar before the first sync of the session has finished, while the list is still the copy kept on this computer.

data.name: SyncAgoJustNow
data.comment: How long ago the last sync was, when it was a few seconds ago. It follows "Synced".

data.name: SyncAgoSeconds
data.comment: {0} is a whole number of seconds.

data.name: SyncAgoMinutes
data.comment: {0} is a whole number of minutes.

data.name: SyncAgoHours
data.comment: {0} is a whole number of hours.

data.name: SyncAgoDays
data.comment: {0} is a whole number of days.

data.name: StatusTickedOff
data.comment: In the status bar for a moment after a task's ticked off, while it's still in the list. {0} is the undo shortcut as the menus write it, such as Ctrl+Z. Lower case: it follows the count of tasks.

data.name: StatusCompletedTruncated
data.comment: In the status bar while completed tasks are shown and Todoist had more than it sends at once, so only the latest are in the list. Lower case: it follows the count of tasks.

data.name: CaptureHint
data.comment: The #project /section @label p1 are literal examples of the quick-add syntax.

data.name: CaptureHintWithDay
data.comment: As CaptureHint, with a day example for accounts that read dates from the text.

data.name: CaptureProjectUnknown
data.comment: {0} is the project name typed, which no project matches.

data.name: CaptureSectionUnknown
data.comment: {0} is the section name typed, which no section matches.

data.name: CaptureNeedsConnection
data.comment: {0} is a comma-separated list of what the offline parser couldn't settle.

data.name: CaptureNoRepeat
data.value: A repeat is Todoist's to read, so it can't be set from a capture — the task wasn't added.
data.comment: Shown in the quick-add box when the typed task names a recurrence the local grammar can't honour.

data.name: CaptureWillRemind
data.comment: {0} is a comma-separated list of the reminders a capture's "!" will set, e.g. "2026-10-23 15:00, 30m before".

data.name: CaptureReminderNoPlan
data.value: (can't remind — reminders aren't on this plan: {0})
data.comment: {0} is the list of reminders the "!" named, which the plan won't take so none is set.

data.name: CaptureReminderWhenDue
data.comment: One of the reminders in the list after "remind": one that goes off when the task's due. Short and lower case, like the rest of the line under the capture box.

data.name: CaptureReminderHoursBefore_Other
data.comment: One of the reminders in the list after "remind": one that goes off a whole number of hours before the task's due. {0} is how many hours. English writes the h the same at one as at ten, so there's no _One.

data.name: CaptureReminderMinutesBefore_Other
data.comment: One of the reminders in the list after "remind": one that goes off a number of minutes before the task's due. {0} is how many minutes. English writes the m the same at one as at ten, so there's no _One.

data.name: DayBoxNoDue
data.comment: Under the due-date box while it's empty, which OK takes as clearing the date.

data.name: DayBoxDueRepeats
data.value: Repeats — Todoist works out the dates when it syncs
data.comment: Under the due-date box when what's typed is a repeating schedule, such as "every monday", which only Todoist turns into dates.

data.name: DayBoxDueForTodoist
data.value: Todoist reads this when it syncs
data.comment: Under the due-date box when what's typed isn't a day Termyn can read, so it goes to Todoist as it was typed.

data.name: DayBoxNoDeadline
data.comment: Under the deadline box while it's empty, which OK takes as clearing the deadline.

data.name: DayBoxDeadlineTimed
data.value: A deadline is a whole day, without a time
data.comment: Under the deadline box when what's typed has a time in it, which a deadline can't hold. OK waits for a day without one.

data.name: DayBoxDeadlineRepeats
data.comment: Under the deadline box when what's typed is a repeating schedule. OK waits for a single day.

data.name: DayBoxDeadlineUnread
data.value: Not a day this can read — try “{0}” or “{1}”
data.comment: Under the deadline box when what's typed can't be read as a day. {0} and {1} are two days typed the way the box reads them, such as 4 aug and in 3 days, or 25/12 and 2026-12-25.

data.name: DayBoxReminderRepeats
data.comment: In the reminders dialog, under the box for when a reminder goes off, when what's typed is a repeating schedule.

data.name: DayBoxReminderUnread
data.value: Not a day and time this can read — try “{0}”
data.comment: In the reminders dialog, under the box for when a reminder goes off, when what's typed can't be read as a moment. {0} is a day and time typed the way the box reads them, such as tomorrow 9am or 25/12 09:00.

data.name: DayBoxDayAtTime
data.comment: Under a date box, the day it read from what's typed when there's a time with it. {0} is the day written in full, such as "Tuesday, 4 August 2026", and {1} is the time, such as "16:30".

data.name: FailureChangeSubject
data.comment: {0} is what was being done, {1} what it was being done to.

data.name: FailureItemAdd
data.comment: In the failed changes window, a change Todoist turned down: what was being done when it was made.

data.name: FailureItemUpdate
data.comment: In the failed changes window, a change Todoist turned down: what was being done when it was made.

data.name: FailureItemDelete
data.comment: In the failed changes window, a change Todoist turned down: what was being done when it was made.

data.name: FailureItemClose
data.comment: In the failed changes window, a change Todoist turned down: what was being done when it was made.

data.name: FailureItemUncomplete
data.comment: In the failed changes window, a change Todoist turned down: what was being done when it was made.

data.name: FailureItemMove
data.comment: In the failed changes window, a change Todoist turned down: what was being done when it was made.

data.name: FailureItemReorder
data.comment: In the failed changes window, a change Todoist turned down: what was being done when it was made.

data.name: FailureProjectReorder
data.comment: In the failed changes window, a change Todoist turned down: what was being done when it was made.

data.name: FailureSectionReorder
data.comment: In the failed changes window, a change Todoist turned down: what was being done when it was made.

data.name: FailureProjectAdd
data.comment: In the failed changes window, a change Todoist turned down: what was being done when it was made.

data.name: FailureSectionAdd
data.comment: In the failed changes window, a change Todoist turned down: what was being done when it was made.

data.name: FailureLabelAdd
data.comment: In the failed changes window, a change Todoist turned down: what was being done when it was made.

data.name: FailureLabelDelete
data.comment: In the failed changes window, a change Todoist turned down: what was being done when it was made.

data.name: FailureNoteAdd
data.comment: In the failed changes window, a change Todoist turned down: what was being done when it was made.

data.name: FailureReminderAdd
data.comment: In the failed changes window, a change Todoist turned down: what was being done when it was made.

data.name: FailureReasonGiven
data.comment: {0} is the server's own words, passed through as it sent them.

data.name: FailureReasonNone
data.comment: In the failed changes window, the first line about a change Todoist turned down without saying why.

data.name: FailureLandedUnruled
data.value: Todoist never reported a result, so whether your account has this is unknown.
data.comment: In the failed changes window, under what Todoist said: a change Termyn gave up on after Todoist went on saying nothing about it.

data.name: FailureLandedRefused
data.value: Todoist refused it, so your account doesn't have it.
data.comment: In the failed changes window, under what Todoist said: a change Todoist turned down outright.

data.name: FailureCostDiscards
data.value: Dismissing removes Termyn's copy, which is the only one on this machine.
data.comment: In the failed changes window, last: what dismissing costs when the change was adding something, which exists only on this computer until Todoist takes it.

data.name: FailureCostKept
data.value: Termyn has already put this back. Dismissing only clears the notice.
data.comment: In the failed changes window, last: dismissing a refused change to something that already existed, which Termyn has undone on this machine.

data.name: SidebarFavourites
data.comment: Heading in the sidebar over the starred projects, labels and filters.

data.name: SidebarProjects
data.comment: Heading in the sidebar over the account's projects.

data.name: SidebarLabels
data.comment: Heading in the sidebar over the account's labels, the tags on tasks.

data.name: SidebarFilters
data.comment: Heading in the sidebar over the account's saved filters.

data.name: SmartViewToday
data.comment: The built-in view of what's due today or overdue. At the top of the sidebar and in the path above the list.

data.name: SmartViewUpcoming
data.comment: The built-in view of what's due in the next week, under a heading for each day. At the top of the sidebar and in the path above the list.

data.name: SmartViewInbox
data.comment: The built-in view of the Inbox, the project a task goes to when nothing says where. At the top of the sidebar and in the path above the list.

data.name: SmartViewAll
data.comment: The built-in view of every task, in the path above the list.

data.name: SearchResults
data.comment: The path above the task list while a search is on, standing in for the name of the view: a search covers the whole account rather than the view that was open.

data.name: FilterNoQuery
data.comment: In the notice over a saved filter Termyn can't read, in place of the filter's query when it has none.

data.name: PanelTask
data.comment: The heading over the panel under the list while it's showing a task's description and comments. {0} is the task's name.

data.name: PanelProject
data.comment: The heading over the panel under the list while it's showing a project's description and comments. {0} is the project's name.

data.name: CommentNotSentYet
data.comment: Above a comment in the panel, in place of when it was posted, while it's waiting on this computer to be sent to Todoist.

data.name: CommentNoMessage
data.comment: In place of a comment's text when it's a file with no words.

data.name: CommentEmpty
data.comment: In place of a comment's text when it has neither words nor a file.

data.name: CommentFileProcessing
data.comment: Above a comment in the panel, the file on it while Todoist is still taking the upload in. {0} is the file's name.

data.name: FileSizeBytes_Other
data.comment: A file's size beside its name above a comment, when it's under a kilobyte. {0} is the number of bytes. English writes the B the same at one as at ten, so there's no _One.

data.name: FileSizeKilobytes
data.comment: A file's size beside its name above a comment. {0} is the size in kilobytes, to one decimal place at most, such as 2.5.

data.name: FileSizeMegabytes
data.comment: A file's size beside its name above a comment. {0} is the size in megabytes, to one decimal place at most, such as 2.5.

data.name: FileSizeGigabytes
data.comment: A file's size beside its name above a comment. {0} is the size in gigabytes, to one decimal place at most, such as 2.5.

data.name: DownloadsUnavailable
data.value: Downloads aren't available in this window.
data.comment: Said on opening or saving a comment's file from a window that has nowhere to download it to.

data.name: UploadOutlivedComment
data.value: The file was taken off the comment, but Todoist couldn't be reached to delete the upload itself.
data.comment: Said after removing a file from a comment while Todoist couldn't be reached: the comment no longer has it, but the uploaded copy is still on Todoist's servers.

data.name: HistoryTaskNamed
data.comment: How the lines below quote a task. {0} is the task's name.

data.name: HistoryTaskUnnamed
data.comment: How the lines below refer to a task with no name to quote, such as one that's gone from the account. Lower case: it sits in the middle of a sentence.

data.name: HistoryAdded
data.comment: A task added from the capture box. {0} is what was typed for it.

data.name: HistoryAddedUnder
data.comment: A sub-task added. {0} is its name, and {1} is the task it went under, quoted as HistoryTaskNamed quotes it.

data.name: HistoryReopened
data.comment: A completed task put back. {0} is the task, quoted as HistoryTaskNamed quotes it.

data.name: HistoryRenamed
data.comment: A task renamed. {0} is the task under its old name, quoted as HistoryTaskNamed quotes it, and {1} is its new name.

data.name: HistoryDescriptionEdited
data.comment: A task's description changed. {0} is the task, quoted as HistoryTaskNamed quotes it.

data.name: HistoryDescriptionEditedProject
data.value: Edited the description of a project
data.comment: A project's description changed.

data.name: HistoryCommentAdded
data.comment: A comment added to a task or a project.

data.name: HistoryCommentEdited
data.comment: A comment's text changed.

data.name: HistoryCommentDeleted
data.comment: A comment deleted.

data.name: HistoryPriorityCleared
data.comment: A task set back to no priority. {0} is the task, quoted as HistoryTaskNamed quotes it.

data.name: HistoryPrioritySet
data.comment: {0} is the task, quoted as HistoryTaskNamed quotes it. {1} is the priority number, 1 to 3.

data.name: HistoryDueSet
data.comment: {0} is the task, quoted as HistoryTaskNamed quotes it. {1} is a short date such as "4 Mar".

data.name: HistoryDueCleared
data.comment: A task's due date taken off. {0} is the task, quoted as HistoryTaskNamed quotes it.

data.name: HistoryDueSetText
data.comment: {0} is the task, quoted as HistoryTaskNamed quotes it. {1} is the due wording the user typed, such as "every Monday".

data.name: HistoryDeadlineSet
data.comment: A task given a deadline. {0} is the task, quoted as HistoryTaskNamed quotes it. {1} is a short date such as "4 Mar".

data.name: HistoryDeadlineCleared
data.comment: A task's deadline taken off. {0} is the task, quoted as HistoryTaskNamed quotes it.

data.name: HistoryCompleted
data.comment: A task ticked off. {0} is the task, quoted as HistoryTaskNamed quotes it.

data.name: HistoryDeleted
data.comment: A task deleted. {0} is the task, quoted as HistoryTaskNamed quotes it.

data.name: HistoryUndo
data.comment: Undo used.

data.name: HistoryMovedUp
data.comment: A task moved one place up among the tasks beside it. {0} is the task, quoted as HistoryTaskNamed quotes it.

data.name: HistoryMovedDown
data.comment: A task moved one place down among the tasks beside it. {0} is the task, quoted as HistoryTaskNamed quotes it.

data.name: HistoryIndented
data.comment: A task made a sub-task of the one above it. {0} is the task, quoted as HistoryTaskNamed quotes it.

data.name: HistoryOutdented
data.comment: A sub-task lifted out to sit beside its parent. {0} is the task, quoted as HistoryTaskNamed quotes it.

data.name: HistoryMovedTo
data.comment: A task sent to another project or section. {0} is the task, quoted as HistoryTaskNamed quotes it, and {1} is where it went, such as "Work / Planning".

data.name: HistoryMovedUnder
data.comment: A task dragged onto another, which it's now a sub-task of. {0} is the task dragged and {1} the one it went under, each quoted as HistoryTaskNamed quotes it.

data.name: HistoryMoved
data.comment: A task dragged to a new place in the list. {0} is the task, quoted as HistoryTaskNamed quotes it.

data.name: HistoryReminderAdded
data.comment: A reminder added to a task. {0} is the task, quoted as HistoryTaskNamed quotes it.

data.name: HistoryReminderRemoved
data.comment: A reminder taken off a task.

data.name: HistoryLabelAdded
data.comment: A label made. {0} is its name.

data.name: HistoryProjectAdded
data.comment: A project made. {0} is its name.

data.name: HistoryProjectRenamed
data.comment: A project renamed. {0} is its new name.

data.name: HistoryProjectDeleted
data.comment: A project deleted. {0} is its name.

data.name: HistoryProjectDeletedUnnamed
data.comment: A project deleted, when there's no name to give it.

data.name: HistorySectionAdded
data.comment: A section made. {0} is its name.

data.name: HistorySectionRenamed
data.comment: A section renamed. {0} is its new name.

data.name: HistorySectionDeleted
data.comment: A section deleted. {0} is its name.

data.name: HistorySectionDeletedUnnamed
data.comment: A section deleted, when there's no name to give it.

data.name: HistoryProjectMovedUp
data.comment: A project moved one place up in the sidebar. {0} is its name.

data.name: HistoryProjectMovedDown
data.comment: A project moved one place down in the sidebar. {0} is its name.

data.name: HistorySectionMovedUp
data.comment: A section moved one place up within its project. {0} is its name.

data.name: HistorySectionMovedDown
data.comment: A section moved one place down within its project. {0} is its name.

data.name: HistoryProjectMoved
data.comment: A project dragged to a new place in the sidebar. {0} is its name.

data.name: HistorySectionMoved
data.comment: A section dragged to a new place in the sidebar. {0} is its name.

data.name: SwitchAccountLeadUnknown
data.value: Todoist didn't say which account that token is for, so Termyn can't tell whether it's this one.
data.comment: The first paragraph of the question asked on pasting a token, when Todoist hasn't said whose it is.

data.name: SwitchAccountLeadOther
data.value: That token is for a different Todoist account.
data.comment: The first paragraph of the question asked on pasting a token that belongs to another account.

data.name: SwitchAccountBody
data.value: Using it removes this account's tasks, comments, downloaded files and the list of what you've done from this computer, and then signs in to the other one. Nothing is removed from Todoist itself.
data.comment: The second paragraph of the question asked on pasting a token for another account: what using it does.

data.name: SwitchAccountPending_One
data.value: {0} change hasn't reached Todoist yet, and switching now loses it. Paste a token for the account it belongs to and it will be sent.
data.comment: {0} is the count of unsent changes, never nought: with none, nothing is said.

data.name: SwitchAccountPending_Other
data.value: {0} changes haven't reached Todoist yet, and switching now loses them. Paste a token for the account they belong to and they will be sent.
data.comment: {0} is the count of unsent changes, never nought: with none, nothing is said.

data.name: SignOutQuestionHead
data.comment: The first line of the question asked before signing out.

data.name: SignOutBody
data.value: Termyn will forget your token, and remove the account's tasks, comments, downloaded files and the list of what you've done from this computer. Nothing is removed from Todoist itself.
data.comment: Under the question asked before signing out: what signing out does.

data.name: SignOutPending_One
data.value: {0} change hasn't reached Todoist yet, and signing out now loses it. Sync first if you want to keep it.
data.comment: {0} is the count of unsent changes, never nought: with none, nothing is said.

data.name: SignOutPending_Other
data.value: {0} changes haven't reached Todoist yet, and signing out now loses them. Sync first if you want to keep them.
data.comment: {0} is the count of unsent changes, never nought: with none, nothing is said.

data.name: ReminderWhenDue
data.comment: A reminder that goes off at the moment the task is due.

data.name: ReminderMinutesBefore_One
data.comment: A reminder that goes off a while before the task is due. {0} is how many minutes.

data.name: ReminderMinutesBefore_Other
data.comment: A reminder that goes off a while before the task is due. {0} is how many minutes.

data.name: ReminderHoursBefore_One
data.comment: A reminder that goes off a whole number of hours before the task is due. {0} is how many hours.

data.name: ReminderHoursBefore_Other
data.comment: A reminder that goes off a whole number of hours before the task is due. {0} is how many hours.

data.name: ReminderDaysBefore_One
data.comment: A reminder that goes off a whole number of days before the task is due. {0} is how many days.

data.name: ReminderDaysBefore_Other
data.comment: A reminder that goes off a whole number of days before the task is due. {0} is how many days.

data.name: ReminderAt
data.comment: A reminder that goes off once. {0} is when, such as "Fri, 14 Aug 09:30", or Todoist's own text for it when that can't be read.

data.name: ReminderAtUnknownTime
data.comment: A reminder that goes off once, at a time Todoist hasn't said.

data.name: ReminderRepeating
data.comment: A reminder that repeats. {0} is its schedule in Todoist's own words, such as "Every sat 9am", and {1} is when it next goes off, such as "Sat, 24 Oct 09:00".

data.name: ReminderAtPlace
data.comment: A reminder that goes off on arriving at or leaving a place, which only Todoist can set. {0} is the place's name.

data.name: ReminderAtUnnamedPlace
data.comment: A reminder that goes off on arriving at or leaving a place Todoist hasn't named.

data.name: ReminderSetElsewhere
data.comment: A reminder of a kind Termyn doesn't know, set from one of Todoist's own apps.

data.name: DayHeadingTomorrow
data.comment: Names tomorrow in its heading, in place of the weekday, after the date: "27 Oct · Tomorrow".
